title: 02 · procession · The Groom's Procession
lines: Parvati's mother fainted at her own daughter's wedding.
Because she had just seen the groom.
Every king arrives with elephants and gold.
with a snake around his neck.
And behind him danced his family.
Every creature nobody else would invite.
I will not give my daughter to this.
"I will not give my daughter to this."
She had seen what he really was, long ago.
The most beautiful groom the three worlds had ever seen.
He did not change for the world.
He changed for one frightened mother.
And he kept every ghost at his side.
He takes you as you are. That is sadhana.
